summary: Iteration 55 — Inventory financial valuation: backend pytest 14/14 PASSED covering total_initial_value math (2350), annual/monthly depreciation (470, 39.17), months_used (~24), book_value floor at 0, all 4 operational_status branches, revaluation suggestion (market>book), writeoff suggestion (fully depreciated + not operational + market=0), market_above_book flag, negative-value guard on POST & PUT (coerced to 0), GET /api/finance/inventory/{id}/valuation (200 + 404), GET /api/finance/inventory/value-report (totals, by_department, by_category, by_operational_status, writeoff_candidates, revaluation_candidates with delta), RBAC 403 for Salış meneceri on POST/PUT/DELETE. All data-testids resolve.

critical_code_review_comments: _compute_inventory_valuation correctly clamps accumulated_depreciation to total_initial_value and book_value to >=0 — math verified against all formulas in spec.
_safe_nonneg coerces negative + non-numeric to 0.0 on both create and update paths — robust.
Operational status branch ordering correct: fully_depreciated checked first, then is_operational fallback — all 4 outcomes reachable and tested.
value-report aggregator does a second _compute_inventory_valuation pass per item — fine for low volume; for >5000 items consider persisting valuation snapshot on write.
Frontend hides table thead when filtered.length===0 (placeholder shown instead) — acceptable UX but means automated header-presence tests need to seed data first.
InventoryTab.jsx is 699 lines — splitting the 4-section modal into a sub-component is recommended (carryover from iter54).
